scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Gleipnir is said to be so strong that not even the Fenrir Wolf could break it! I take great pride in being able to create this!
[Rebarev Doug]
I didn't think
you'd actually do it.
But you'll be sorry later...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
没想到你真的会这么做。
但你以后会后悔的...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Gleipnir is said to be so strong that not even the Fenrir Wolf could break it! I take great pride in being able to create this!
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't you get it?
The elite and powerful rule this world. I am untouchable! And the weak and the lowly can rot in hell! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你不懂吗？
这个世界的规则是由
精英和强者制定的。
我是不可触碰的！
而弱者和卑微之人
只能在地狱中腐烂！
呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Gleipnir is said to be so strong that not even the Fenrir Wolf could break it! I take great pride in being able to create this!
[Rebarev Doug]
You're not fit
to even speak to me.
Even if you are an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你甚至不配与我对话。
即使你是冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We are Crusaders that have
been training in preparation
for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我们是十字军，
一直在为即将到来的圣战
进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As our forefathers have
done a thousand years ago, we shall vanquish the hordes of Demons when the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
正如我们的先辈
在一千年前所做的那样，
当那一天到来时，
我们将歼灭恶魔大军。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If you have any questions about Crusaders, feel free to ask me.
I may be too old and weak for fighting, but I will spread our message as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果您对十字军有任何疑问，
请随时问我。
虽然我可能太老、太弱，
无法再战斗，
但我会尽我所能
传播我们的信念。

scripts.text: What is Holy Cross?
scripts.translation: 什么是圣十字攻击？

scripts.text: What is Grand Cross?
scripts.translation: 什么是圣十字审判？

scripts.text: What is Sacrifice?
scripts.translation: 什么是牺牲？

scripts.text: What is Gleipnir?
scripts.translation: 什么是魔法铁链？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Holy Cross is the first manifestation of a Crusader's faith. By making the sign of the cross, Crusader's can inflict a holy attack on their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
圣十字攻击是十字军信仰的第一种体现。通过画十字，十字军可以对敌人发动神圣攻击。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Monsters that are weak against holiness, particularly the Undead, will be blinded by the light of the Holy Cross. All they can do is wait for holy judgment.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
对神圣属性脆弱的魔物，特别是亡灵，会被圣十字攻击的光芒致盲。它们只能等待神圣的审判。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Based on our latest research,
the Holy Cross can inflict 4.5 times more damage than a normal attack once it is mastered.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
根据我们最新的研究，圣十字攻击一旦精通，造成的伤害将是普通攻击的4.5倍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Grand Cross...!
The righteous fury of God is
given form in this destructive skill.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
圣十字审判...
上帝的正义之怒，
在这个毁灭性的技能中具象化。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
God grants us his power so that
we may punish the forces of evil, and one's rage is embodied in a giant crucifix of power.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
上帝赐予我们力量，
让我们惩罚邪恶势力，
而人的愤怒则化身为巨大的力量十字架。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
The power of the crucifix of light can damage the enemy three times. Each strike will have five times the strength of your normal attacks.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
光之十字架的力量可以对敌人造成三次伤害。每次打击的威力都是普通攻击的五倍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, when Crusaders use Grand Cross, they must exercise extreme caution. The human body is too weak to fully embrace the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
然而，当十字军使用圣十字审判时，必须极度谨慎。人类的身体太脆弱，无法完全承受上帝的意志。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Therefore, using this skill, will cause the Crusader to suffer from damage. However, this damage can
be reduced to half with Faith.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
因此，使用这个技能会导致十字军受到伤害。不过，通过信任技能，可以将这种伤害减少一半。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
In practicing what we preach, Crusaders choose to protect
others by bearing the suffering of their fellow man.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
为了践行我们的教义，十字军选择通过承受同胞的痛苦来保护他人。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
The Sacrifice skill allows Crusaders to keep their comrades safe from harm by receiving the damage that was intended for them.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
牺牲技能允许十字军承受原本指向同伴的伤害，从而保护他们的安全。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It is the greatest demonstration of faith,
as well as of love for your comrades. Such an attitude is essential for a servant of God!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
这是信仰的最伟大体现，
也是对同伴之爱的证明。这种态度对于上帝的仆人来说是必不可少的！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, if the people you want to protect stray away from you, you cannot use the Sacrifice skill for them unless they are close to you again.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过，如果你想保护的人离你太远，你就无法对他们使用牺牲技能，除非他们再次靠近你。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As you visualize the suffering of those you want to protect, you'll never hesitate to sacrifice yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
当你想象着你想保护的人所受的苦难时，你就再也不会犹豫去牺牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Thank you, God, for granting me with the power to protect my people.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
感谢上帝赐予我保护人民的力量。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Gleipnir is the essence of Megingjard which I have been researching.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
魔法铁链是我一直在研究的雷神腰带的精髓。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It's the only binding strong enough that will allow a human to wear Megingjard around his waist.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
它是唯一足够强韧的束缚，能让人类将雷神腰带系在腰间。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Although I can no longer fight, I've been studying how to create Gleipnir for years. I will be more than willing to create it for you if you can bring me...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
虽然我不能再战斗了，但我已经研究如何制作魔法铁链多年了。如果你能给我带来...我很乐意为你制作它。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
^0000FF4 Cat Tread^000000,
^0000FF5 Woman's Moustache^000000,
^0000FF4 Root of Stone^000000,
^0000FF3 Sputum of Bird^000000 and
^0000FF3 Sinew of Bear^000000.

[Rebarev Doug]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Why are you wandering
around this sacred place?
Do you not understand that
we must prepare for
the Holy War?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你为什么在这神圣之地游荡？
难道你不知道我们必须为圣战做准备吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
No matter how much I explain, the ignorant never fully understand the importance of our task. The balance of power will shift when we least expect it!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
无论我如何解释，无知的人永远无法完全理解我们任务的重要性。当力量平衡发生转变时，往往是在我们最意想不到的时候！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wish I could go back
to those times when I would
train Crusaders, rather than
preach to the ignorant.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我真希望能回到过去，那时我训练十字军，而不是向无知的人布道。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I miss my Crusaders who
were enthusiastic to listen to what I had to say, and carried out their orders with loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我怀念我的十字军们，他们曾热情地聆听我的教诲，并忠诚地执行命令。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I am wonder
where they have
all gone now...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我想知道
他们现在都去了哪里...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Adventurer, if you have the time to listen to me speak to myself, why don't you perform a task for me?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
冒险者，既然你有时间听我自说自话，何不为我做一件事呢？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It may be an enriching
experience for you. It's possible that you'll even have a greater appreciation for Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
这对你来说可能是一次有益的经历。你甚至可能会更加理解十字军。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: I'm sick and tired of doin' favors.
scripts.translation: 我受够了帮这种忙。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I want you to find the members of the 1st Squad in the 3rd Platoon of the 3rd Company. If you happen to encounter them in your travels, please ask them how they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我要你找到第三大队第三连第一小队的成员。如果你在旅途中遇到他们，请询问他们的近况。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It shouldn't be that difficult to do and won't be a waste of your time if you are already planning
to explore the world.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
这并不难，如果你本来就打算探索世界，这也不会浪费你的时间。

scripts.text: Sure, why not.
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but no.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不行。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Excellent!
All I want you to do is find my old comrades, and inform me of how
they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
太好了！
我只需要你找到我的老战友，并告诉我他们的近况。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However...
There is one problem.
I don't where they are.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
但是...
有一个问题。
我不知道他们在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You could try to find a record of residency changes by citizens of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom in
the Prontera Library...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你可以尝试在普隆德拉图书馆查找卢恩·米德加兹王国市民的居住变动记录...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, the records of
Crusader personnel is considered confidential, so I am not sure of whether or not you can view them.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过，十字军的人员记录被视为机密，我不确定你是否能查阅到。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You must understand, my position requires me to remain in this area 24 hours, 7 days a week. I cannot leave without the consent of the upper hierarchy.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你必须理解，我的职位要求我每周七天、每天24小时都留在这个区域。没有上级许可，我不能离开。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, I know you have the freedom and the time to go wherever you please. I'd appreciate if you would do this for me.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
但是，我知道你有自由和时间去任何你想去的地方。如果你能帮我做这件事，我将不胜感激。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
My old comrades in arms.
You have no idea how much
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我昔日的战友。
我真不知道有多想念他们...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Please understand that
I would not be asking this
of you if it were not for
the restraints of
my position.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
^333333*叹息...*^000000
请理解，若非受限于我的职位，
我绝不会提出这样的请求。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I have an obligation to this Kingdom to keep my post and
inform adventurers about the
Crusader class. Because of this
awesome responsibility, I must
remain here, ever vigilant.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我有义务效忠王国，坚守岗位，
并向冒险者介绍十字军职业。
正因为这份沉重的责任，
我必须留在这里，时刻警惕。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If you can't understand, then you must be taking your freedom for granted...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果你无法理解，那你一定是太把自由当回事了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As far as I remember, this is the first time I have asked you to do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
据我所知，这是我第一次请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Unlike you, I know the meaning
of responsibility. I remain here, helping inquisitive adventurers for the sake of King and country.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不像你，我深知责任的意义。
我留在这里，为了国王和国家，帮助那些好奇的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Still...
Know this.
Although the results may not be immediate, you will always be rewarded when you help others.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过...
请记住。
虽然回报可能不会立刻显现，但当你帮助他人时，终将得到回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Please reconsider
when you get the chance.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
请你在有机会时重新考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wonder how my old
comrades are doing now.
I can't even remember
the last time I saw them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不知道我昔日的战友现在过得如何。
我甚至记不清上次见到他们是什么时候了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hmm...?
Haven't you left
to search for them yet?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你还没出发去找他们吗？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我该去哪里？

scripts.text: I am about to leave.
scripts.translation: 我正准备出发。

scripts.text: What do you mean by final mission?
scripts.translation: 你说的最后任务是指什么？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Well...
You should be able
find some clue as to
where to find them through
^0000FFThe Platoon Records^000000 in
the Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...
你应该能在普隆德拉图书馆的
^0000FF《第三排班记录》^000000中
找到一些关于他们下落的线索。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, you are...
I wonder what they
have been doing since
our ^0000FFfinal mission^000000...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，原来是你...
真不知道自那次^0000FF最后任务^000000以来，
他们都在做些什么...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Final mission...?
Well, I can't recall
everything at the moment,
but it was the reason why
our squad broke up.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
最后任务...？
嗯，我现在记不清所有细节了，
但那是我们小队解散的原因。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We were a great team.
But in the military system,
you need to follow the orders
of your superiors...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我们曾是一支优秀的队伍。

你必须服从上级的命令...

scripts.text:

...
scripts.translation:

...

......

[Rebarev Doug]

scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
别谈那个了。重要的是，我们小队因为未能完成最后任务而解散了。现在，请帮我去普隆德拉图书馆找一下^0000FF《第三排班记录》^000000好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Remember, it might be helpful to ask the librarian for the file with a record on ^660000the 1st squad's final mission^000000.
scripts.translation:

记住，询问图书管理员关于^660000第一小队最后任务^000000的记录可能会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wonder how my old
comrades are doing now.
I can't even remember
the last time I saw them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不知道我昔日的战友现在过得如何。
我甚至记不清上次见到他们是什么时候了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hmm...?
Haven't you left
to search for them yet?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你还没出发去找他们吗？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我该去哪里？

scripts.text: I am about to leave.
scripts.translation: 我正准备出发。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Well...
You should be able
find some clue as to
where to find them through
^0000FFThe 3rd Platoon Records^000000 in
the Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...
你应该能在普隆德拉图书馆的
^0000FF第三排班记录^000000中
找到一些关于他们下落的线索。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, you are...
I wonder what they
have been doing since
our ^0000FFfinal mission^000000...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，原来是你...
真不知道自那次^0000FF最后任务^000000以来，
他们都在做些什么...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Huh...?
The librarian
didn't let you
read the records?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
咦...？
图书管理员
不让你查阅记录吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
He may have responsibility,
but at the end of the day, he's just like you and me. You can find some way to convince him to help you, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
他虽然身负重任，
但说到底，他和你我一样都是普通人。
我相信你一定能找到办法说服他帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Please, I beg you,
would you find out
what happened to the
rest of the 1st Squad?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
拜托了，求求你，
请查明第一小队
其余成员发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh...
It might be helpful to know that we were the ^660000Crusader Third Company, Third Platoon, First Squad^000000.
scripts.translation:

哦...
知道这一点可能会有帮助：我们是
^660000十字军第三营第三排第一小队^000000。

scripts.text:

Oh...
So did you meet them?
Are they all okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦...
那你见到他们了吗？
大家都还好吗？

scripts.text:

A man's life is too
short and his friends
are too few. Please find
out how my old comrades
are doing for me.
scripts.translation:

挚友难求。
请替我查明
我昔日战友的近况。

哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't you get it?
The elite and powerful rule this world. I am untouchable! And the weak and the lowly can rot in hell! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:

你不明白吗？
这个世界的统治者是精英和强者。我是不可触碰的！而弱者和卑微者就该在地狱里腐烂！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Do you hate me?
Do you really hate me?
Take a look at this face.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你恨我吗？
你真的恨我吗？
看看这张脸。

face of authority!

a trial. But do you really want to reveal this to the public?

been training in preparation
for the Holy War that is to come.

scripts.text:

done a thousand years ago, we shall vanquish the hordes of Demons when the day comes.

正如我们的先辈
在一千年前所做的那样，
当那一天到来时，
我们将歼灭恶魔大军。

[图书管理员 杰坎]
如果你^660000不^000000妨碍
我的工作，
我会非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Darn it...!
I can't read anything when the light is this dim! It's bad enough my eyes have gone bad...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
该死...！
光线这么暗，我什么都看不清！我的视力本来就不好了...

scripts.text: You have bad eyes?
scripts.translation: 你的视力不好吗？

scripts.text: I want to read some documents.
scripts.translation: 我想读一些文件。

scripts.text: Let me help you find those files...
scripts.translation: 让我帮你找那些文件...

scripts.text: What kind of files are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在找什么样的文件？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I've worked
under dim light
for so long, my eyes have
gone bad. They should get me ^0000FFa new light^000000, otherwise I'll go blind sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我在昏暗的光线下工作太久了，视力变差了。他们应该给我^0000FF一盏新灯^000000，否则我迟早会失明的...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hey, that's some pretty useful stuff that you've got with you. Do you mind letting me borrow it for a while? It'll help me in finding those files...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嘿，你身上带着一些很有用的东西。介意借给我用一会儿吗？这会帮我找到那些文件...

scripts.text: Yes, I mind!
scripts.translation: 是的，我介意！

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
^333333*Sniff*^000000
N-never mind...

[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, you are so kind!
Y-you really do want
to help me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
你真是太好了！
你...你真的愿意帮我，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you...
Now I won't have to
worry so much about
finding that file.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
谢谢你...
这样我就不必那么担心
找不到那份文件了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
If it's alright,
would you help me
look for it...?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
如果不介意的话，
你能帮我找找吗...？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you...
The stuff you let
me borrow will really
help me in looking for
all of those files...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
谢谢你...
你借给我的东西
真的能帮我找到
那些文件...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Read some documents?
Well, you've come here
to the Library. That's
a good start.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
阅读一些文件？
既然你来到了图书馆，
那就是个好的开始。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Well, as long as
you know what kind
of document you're
looking for, you might
be able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯，只要你清楚
你在找什么样的文件，
也许就能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekin]
I've got to find that
classified file as soon
as I can!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰金]
我必须尽快找到
那份机密文件！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm...?
Hey, haven't
I told you already?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...？
嘿，我不是已经
告诉过你了吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
The public is prohibited from browsing the files in this section! How many times do I need to repeat myself?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
公众禁止浏览此区域的文件！我要重复多少遍才行？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'd gladly accept your
help if it weren't for the fact that I cannot allow classified information to be released to the public.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我很乐意接受你的帮助，
但我不能允许机密信息
泄露给公众。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I have no idea how something so important was shuffled into the files here in Prontera Library, but we can't allow the public to access it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我不知道这么重要的东西
怎么会混进普隆德拉图书馆的文件里，
但我们不能允许公众接触它。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Still, that file doesn't seem to be that important, but I still have to waste my time on finding it...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
不过，那份文件似乎也没那么重要，
但我还是得浪费时间去寻找它...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Damn, my eyes are sore.
Working as a government official is easy except for the times when the beaucrats make you do stuff like this.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
该死，我的眼睛好痛。
当公务员很容易，
除了那些官僚让你做这种事的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I think I'm going to go
insane looking for this file...!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我觉得我要疯了，
为了找这份文件...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Huh...?
Did you just say
that you wanted to
help me? I-I'd appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
咦...？
你刚才说想帮我？
我...我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Um, you're not even
supposed to know what
kind of file I'm looking for. Even if you did, I'm not allowed to show you what's inside!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯，你甚至不应该知道
我在找什么样的文件。即使你知道，
我也不允许给你看里面的内容！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm. I'm not really allowed to disclose any information related to that file. I'm sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯。我不被允许透露
任何与那份文件相关的信息。
很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But isn't
the file about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但那份文件
是不是关于...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm...?
How did you
know about that?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...？
你是怎么知道
那件事的？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Errmmm...
I don't think so....?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
呃...
我不觉得是那样...？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not touch the files in this section. Usually, it's public domain but it seems that a classified file managed to get misplaced there.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啊，请不要触碰这一区的文件。
通常这里是公开区域，
但似乎有一份机密文件被误放到了那里。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For now, I cannot let anyone without special authorization to look through that section. I must find that file and send it to the Prontera military as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
目前，我不能让没有特别授权的人
查看那一区。
我必须尽快找到那份文件，
并把它送到普隆德拉的军队那里。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ergh! This light isn't bright enough for my eyes. They're starting to get sore again...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
唉！这灯光对我的眼睛来说不够亮。
它们又开始酸痛了...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
So what brings you here? If you're looking for something in particular, you should try another section.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
那么，是什么把你带到这里来的？
如果你在找特定的东西，
你应该去其他区域试试。

scripts.text: I want to read some documents.
scripts.translation: 我想读一些文件。

scripts.text: Do you have bad eyes?
scripts.translation: 你的眼睛不好吗？

scripts.text: Let me help you to find the files.
scripts.translation: 让我帮你找文件。

scripts.text: What kind of files are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在找什么样的文件？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I told you already! The files in this section aren't open to the public right now! Don't make me repeat myself!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我已经说过了！
这一区的文件目前不对公众开放！
别让我再说第二遍！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Since I have worked under a dim light for a long time, my eyes have gone bad.
They should get me a new light, otherwise I will be gone blind sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
因为我在昏暗的灯光下工作了很久，
我的视力变差了。
他们应该给我换一盏新灯，
否则我迟早会失明的...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Um? How do you know what file I am looking for?
You don't even know what is written inside?
Stop interrupting me, leave!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯？你怎么知道我在找什么文件？
你甚至不知道里面写了什么？
别打断我，走开！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm... I am not supposed to reveal anything related to the file.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...我不被允许透露
任何与那份文件相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't the file...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那份文件
是不是关于...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Maybe...
Maybe not~
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
也许吧...
也许不是~

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm? So did you find it? I've been searching for that file for a long time, but I haven't been able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯？所以你找到了吗？
我找那份文件找了好久，
但一直没能找到。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll go ahead and search the right side, so do you think you could search the left?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我先去右边找找，
你能去左边找找吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Did you find it yet? All this time, and I still haven't been able to dig up that file.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
你找到了吗？
这么久了，我还没能挖出那份文件。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll go ahead and check the left side, so would you look for it in the middle or the right side?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我先去左边查查，
你能在中间或右边找找吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah! There it is!
Thank you so much!
I'm glad to see that there are still kind and thoughtful people like you in the world.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啊！就是那个！
非常感谢！
很高兴看到世界上还有像你这样
善良体贴的人。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I really want to give you something to show you my gratitude, but I've got to send this back to the Prontera Military right away.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我很想送您点什么以表谢意，
但我必须立刻把这份文件送回普隆德拉军队。

scripts.text: I want to read the document.
scripts.translation: 我想阅读这份文件

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, right, you mentioned that, didn't you? It doesn't seem seem
so important, but I'm not really quite sure...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
哦，对，您之前提到过这件事，是吗？
看起来似乎没那么重要，
但我也不太确定...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Well, it couldn't hurt if I made a copy of this first for you to read, but I'll need some materials.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯，先为您复制一份也无妨，
但我需要一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll even cast the
Search Magic on it, so that it'll be just like the original. All right, I need the following things to make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我会施放<黑暗搜集者>复制，
让副本和原件一模一样。
好的，制作副本需要以下物品...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
2 Slick Paper,
1 Oil Paper,
3 Squid Ink,
3 Feather of Birds and
20 Blue Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
2 光滑的纸，
1 油纸，
3 墨汁，
3 鸟羽，
20 蓝色魔力矿石。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Please get those as soon as possible, and I'll be here making the other preparations to make a copy.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
请尽快去准备这些材料，
我会在这里做其他复制准备工作。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Also, I'll keep this copy in the Library for you to read, and to prevent it from being leaked to the public. So you'll have to come visit each time you wish to read it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
另外，我会把这份副本留在图书馆供您阅读，
并防止它泄露给公众。
所以每次想读的时候，您都得过来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Okay, now...
Come back here
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
好了，现在...
请尽快回来。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, you came back.
I didn't expect you to return here so quickly. Whatever's inside must be really important for you to know.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
哦，您回来了。
没想到您这么快就回来了。
看来里面的内容对您来说真的很重要。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Anyway, please
give me a moment
while I make that
copy for you.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
总之，请给我一点时间，
我来为您制作副本。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Alright then...
I'll see you in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
那么...
我稍后见。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Have you forgotten
what you need to make
a copy? Alright, let me
tell you again...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
您忘了制作副本需要什么了吗？
好吧，让我再告诉您一遍...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
2 Slick Paper,
1 Oil Paper,
3 Squid Ink,
3 Feather of Birds and
20 Blue Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
2 光滑的纸，
1 油纸，
3 墨汁，
3 鸟羽，
20 蓝色魔力矿石。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Please come
back with those items
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
请尽快带着那些物品回来。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Let me go over and review the document before I make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
让我先过去查看一下文件，
然后再制作副本...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Let me go over and review the document before I make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
让我先过去查看一下文件，
然后再制作副本...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
There you go. As I thought, the document didn't seem to contain any crucially important data.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
好了。正如我所料，
这份文件似乎不包含任何至关重要的数据。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Just remember, this copy needs to stay in the Prontera Library. That means you have to come back if you need to read the document again.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
请记住，这份副本必须留在普隆德拉图书馆。
这意味着如果您需要再次阅读文件，必须回来。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Welcome, my friend!
So, what do you need today?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
欢迎，我的朋友！
那么，您今天需要什么？

scripts.translation:

[Librarian Jekan]
Well...
This is a pretty

scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...
这是相当过时的
魔法搜索版本，
所以如果它让你
感到困扰，
我完全理解。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Now...
First, if you're going to enter a single search term, like someone's name, you would enter '^660000lee_hester^000000' if you were looking up 'Lee Hester.'
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
那么...
首先，如果你要输入
单个搜索词，
比如某个人的名字，
如果你要找“李·海丝特”，
你应该输入'^660000lee_hester^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Don't use any
capital letters!
And use underscores to
indicate spaces between first and last names and within military unit names.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
不要使用任何
大写字母！
并且使用下划线
来表示名字中
名与姓之间
以及军事单位名称
中的空格。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For example, the Fourth Company would be entered as ^6600004th_company^000000. Now... bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
例如，第四营应该
输入为^6600004th_company^000000。
那么...请耐心听我说。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
If you're looking for information on a specific squad, you need to know the Platoon and Company it falls under.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
如果你在寻找
特定小队的信息，
你需要知道它
所属的连和营。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For example, if you wanted to look up the Crusader 4th Squad of the 4th Platoon of the 4th Company, you would input...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
例如，如果你想查找
第四营、第四连、
第四小队的十字军，
你应该输入...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
'^660000crusader 4th_company 4th_platoon 4th_squad record^000000' all in one line exactly like that. I hope this helps you in your search...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
'^660000crusader 4th_company 4th_platoon 4th_squad record^000000'
全部在一行内，
就像那样。希望
这能帮助你搜索...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
You can tell our
government doesn't
really know how to
allocate its funds
and resources.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
你可以看出，
我们的政府
并不真正知道
如何分配
资金和资源。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
First, there's Jawaii.
Do newlyweds really need
an entire island for themselves? Then again, I am single so I'm probably biased.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
首先，有爪哇。
新婚夫妇真的
需要一整个岛屿
作为他们的专属地吗？
不过话说回来，
我是单身，
所以我可能有偏见。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
And look at me.
Geniuses aren't supposed to waste their precious time doing useless things for libraries!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
再看看我。
天才不应该
浪费宝贵的时间
为图书馆做
无用的事情！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not touch any books in that section. ...I'm sure there's nothing there that could be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啊，请不要触碰
那个区域的任何书籍。
...我确信那里
没有任何对你
有用的东西。

scripts.text: Ignore him and check books.
scripts.translation: 无视他并查看书籍

scripts.text: Step back.

scripts.text:

Hey...!
I thought I said
not to touch those!
scripts.translation:

嘿...！
我说过不要
碰那些书！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you. Feel
free to browse through
the other sections.

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
^333333*Phew...*^000000
This work is really getting to me. Going on a mission with my war buddies sounds a lot better than this.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
^333333*呼...*^000000
这份工作真的快把我逼疯了。和战友一起执行任务听起来比这好多了。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
At least in those days, I felt like I was actually doing something useful!
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
至少在那段日子里，我觉得自己真的在做一些有意义的事！

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Hey...
Can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
嘿...
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Ask him about the 1st Squad.
scripts.translation: 询问他关于第一小队的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他最近过得怎么样

scripts.text: Ask him about the 1st Squad's last mission.
scripts.translation: 询问他关于第一小队最后一次任务的事

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Yeah, I was a member of the 1st Squad in the 3rd Platoon a long time ago. How did you know that?
scripts.translation:

是的，很久以前我是第三排第一小队的一员。你怎么会知道这个？

scripts.text:

I miss the guys back in the squad. I wonder how our leader's been doing recently...

我很想念小队里的兄弟们。不知道我们的首领最近过得怎么样...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
...
......

[Zan.Huadoku]
Before we went out on our last mission, the seven of us were like brothers and sisters. If ^FF0000he^000000 didn't disobey the order, we'd still be together today.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
在我们执行最后一次任务之前，我们七个人情同手足。如果^FF0000他^000000没有违抗命令，我们今天应该还在一起。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Wait...
What was his name...?
There's no way I could forget something like that...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
等等...
他的名字是什么...？
我不可能忘记这种事...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
H-how can I not
remember his name!
He's the reason
my life is...!
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我...我怎么可能记不住他的名字！
他是我生命...的原因！

My head hurts...

^3355FF赞看起来非常困惑，眼神开始变得呆滞。你试图再次和他说话，但他完全没有反应。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
How am I been doing?
Well, I work for the Blacksmith Guild, picking out good weapons
to supply the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我过得怎么样？
嗯，我在铁匠公会工作，挑选好的武器供应给十字军。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Sometimes, I get really
bored with what I'm doing. I keep trying to convince myself that my job's important to future Crusaders, but...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
有时候，我会对现在做的事感到非常无聊。我一直试图说服自己，我的工作对未来的十字军很重要，但是...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
You know what?
A lot of people have been asking me weird questions about me recently. I feel like I'm getting spied on, but maybe I'm just getting paranoid.
scripts.translation:

你知道吗？

final mission...

最后一次任务...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
I...
I guess I need something to remind me? I know it happened, but... I'm so confused.
scripts.translation:

我...
我想我需要一些东西来提醒我？我知道那件事发生了，但是...我真的很困惑。

[Cuaque Donon]
I've been working there,
living a quiet life. But now, for some reason, a lot of people want to talk to me about something important.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我在那里工作，过着平静的生活。但现在，不知为何，很多人想找我谈一些重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I don't know what I said or did, but I think when I gave them the right answer, after I could finally remember something, they tried to hurt me.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我不知道自己说了什么或做了什么，但我觉得当我终于想起一些事情并给出正确答案时，他们试图伤害我。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
So now my sister's been hiding
me here. It's boring and lonely, and the guy downstairs is always yelling at me to leave.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
所以现在妹妹把我藏在这里。这里很无聊也很孤独，楼下的那个家伙总是冲我大喊让我离开。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Even the Rogue Guild that
my sister's a part of comes in sometimes to yell at me. They all want me to tell them something I'm supposed to know!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
甚至妹妹所在的流氓公会的人有时也会进来冲我大喊。他们都想让我说出一些我本该知道的事情！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
But I can't remember anything!
This place is safe from dangerous people, but I don't know for how long.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
但我什么都记不起来！这个地方虽然能避开危险的人，但不知道能维持多久。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Even my sister says I have to tell the Rogue Guild what I should know, or they won't protect us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
连妹妹也说我必须告诉流氓公会我本该知道的事，否则他们就不会再保护我们了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
She looked really sad when she
said that. I don't want to let her down or make her upset. She's
all I have left...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
她说这话时看起来很伤心。我不想让她失望或难过。她是我剩下的唯一亲人了...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Oh, I do remember something!
My sister told me not to tell anyone, but I'm gonna tell you...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哦，我记得一件事！
妹妹告诉我不要告诉任何人，但我打算告诉你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCuaque Donon
whispers into your ears.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF夸克·多农
在你耳边低语。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
^666666She said the Rogue Guild wants something from me. So she's gonna send to me to good people that we can trust and can help me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
^666666她说流氓公会想要从我这里得到些什么。所以她打算派一些我们可以信任、能帮上忙的好人来找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
^666666Still, this is the safest place for me for a while. But I'm always ready to run away if I have to.^000000
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
^666666不过，这里目前对我来说是最安全的地方。但如果有必要，我随时准备逃跑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
How have I been doing?
Lots of people have been coming
to see me. They all want me to tell them something I don't even know!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我最近过得怎么样？
很多人来看我。他们都想让我告诉他们一些我甚至都不知道的事情！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
The Rogue Guild promised to
protect me, but they scare the hell out of me sometimes by coming out of the floor all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
流氓公会承诺会保护我，但他们有时突然从地板下钻出来，真的把我吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Oh, and my sister said she's
gonna complain to my old boss about something. She said I used to be fine, but now that I've retired, I'm not the same anymore.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哦，还有，我妹妹说她要去向我的前老板投诉些什么。她说我以前没事，但现在退休了，就不一样了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
But my old boss from when I was a Crusader doesn't wanna meet my sister. So she's gonna ask help from other Rogues to spread some rumors...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
但我当十字军时的前老板不想见我妹妹。所以她打算找其他流氓帮忙散布一些谣言...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Like anyone who works as a Crusader under my old boss will end up like me. You know... broken.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
比如，任何在我前老板手下当十字军的人最后都会像我一样。你知道的...变得残废。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I don't know...
I can't even remember.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我不知道...
我甚至记不清了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wait, that's right!
^0000FFMegingjard^000000! Right.
We found it, and
we knew what it was
just by looking at it!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
等等，对了！
^0000FF雷神腰带^000000！没错。
我们找到了它，
光看就知道它是什么了！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Megingjard^000000!
^FFFFFFListen to him quietly^000000.
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF静静地听他说^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Waaaaaaaah~!
You're the same
as all the others!
Go away from me!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哇啊啊啊~！
你们和其他人一样！
离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I remember after we found it. One of us in the squad had a argument with our old leader. I was keeping night watch and happened to hear it. I think our leader was out of line...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我记得找到它之后。小队里有人和我们的前首领发生了争执。我当时在守夜，碰巧听到了。我觉得我们的首领做得有点过分...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Ergh...
I can't remember
more than that...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
呃...
我记不清更多了...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I'm getting sleepy
and my head hurts.
Let me rest now...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我困了，
头也很痛。
让我休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wh-who are you?!
How the hell did
you get in here?!
Get away from me!
Geeeet awwwway!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
你...你是谁？！
你他妈是怎么
进来的？！
离我远点！
快...快滚开！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wh-who are you?!
How the hell did
you get in here?!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
你...你是谁？！
你怎么进来的？！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wahhhhh...!
My head!
It's hurting so bad!
I'm so s-scared!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哇啊啊啊...！
我的头！
好痛！
我好...好害怕！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Eh...?
Ask him about Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 询问关于雷巴列夫·道格的事。

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他最近过得怎么样

scripts.text: Ask him about the last mission of the 1st Squad.
scripts.translation: 询问关于第一小队最后一次任务的事。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah! Yeah, our old leader back in the 1st Squad. Heh. I haven't seen him since we were disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
啊！对，第一小队以前的首领。呵。自从我们解散后，我就没见过他了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Me? Yeah, I'm always busy recruiting future Crusaders.
We always welcome Swordmen
of great ability!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我？对，我一直忙着招募未来的十字军。
我们永远欢迎能力出众的剑士！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
How does it sound? Why don't you volunteer to become a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
听起来怎么样？何不志愿成为十字军的一员呢？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Last mission?
Eh, I don't really remember it.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
最后一次任务？
呃，我不太记得了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Eh...?
Ask him about Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 询问关于雷巴列夫·道格的事。

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他最近过得怎么样

scripts.text: Ask about 1st Squad's final mission.
scripts.translation: 询问第一小队最后一次任务的事。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah right. Our old leader.
Now I remember: He was
a pretty self righteous jerk
now that I think about it!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
啊对。我们的老首领。
现在我想起来了：仔细想想，他其实是个相当自大的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Can you believe he used to say that ^0000FFno one is more religious than him in this world^000000?! That's egoism right there. And maybe insanity.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
你能相信吗？他以前常说^0000FF这世上没有人比他更虔诚^000000？！这就是自恋。也许还有点疯。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, everyone in the squad
took pride in their faith. When
you're having a rough time in the
real world, you depend on religion, you know?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
总之，小队里的每个人都以自己的信仰为荣。当你在现实世界中过得艰难时，你会依赖宗教，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyways, in the records about
our squad, it says that one of us was punished for insubordination, rebelling or something. That's
a complete lie.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
不管怎样，关于小队的记录里说，我们其中一人因违抗命令或叛乱受到了惩罚。这完全是谎言。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
During our final mission,
our old leader had a huge argument with one us over something we found. I remember it being some kind of godly artifact, but I can't clearly remember what it was.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
在最后一次任务中，我们的老首领和我们其中一人因为发现的东西发生了激烈的争吵。我记得那是某种神圣的遗物，但我记不清具体是什么了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Although there was an obvious dispute, I think it was our squad leader who was out of line.
I... I can't really say...
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
虽然当时有明显的争执，但我认为是小队首领失态了。
我...我真的说不清...

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
I can't for the life of me
remember how the guy who
argued with the squad leader
looked like. The higher-ups
musta did something to me...
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我拼命也想不起来那个和首领争吵的人长什么样。上面的人肯定对我做了什么...

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, I know for sure that whatever that guy did, it wasn't insubordination. In fact, I think he might've been right!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
总之，我确信那个人做的任何事都不是违抗命令。事实上，我觉得他可能是对的！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
That's all I can remember.
I better take some Green Herbs now. My head throbs like crazy whenever I think about that time.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
这就是我能记起的全部了。
我得吃点绿色药草了。每次想起那段时光，我的头就痛得厉害。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah! Yeah, our old leader back in the 1st Squad. Heh. I haven't seen him since we were disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
啊！对，第一小队以前的首领。呵。自从我们解散后，我就没见过他了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Me? Yeah, I'm not doing so bad. Keeping busy recruiting future Crusaders. We welcome all
Swordmen if they show potential~
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我？对，我过得还不错。忙着招募未来的十字军。只要展现出潜力，我们欢迎所有剑士~

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
Why would
you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
哈...？
你为什么
想知道这个？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou tell him what you've read in the records for the 1st Squad. Afterwards, Jack O looks a little confused.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告诉他你在第一小队的记录中读到的内容。之后，杰克·奥看起来有些困惑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
I might not be able to remember
a whole lot from back then, but the part about ^0000FFinsubordination^000000 can't be right. I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
哈...？
我可能记不清那时候的很多事了，但关于^0000FF违抗命令^000000的部分肯定不对。我对此很确定。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Our old leader was
so arrogant to the point
of being a little off his rocker.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我们以前的首领
傲慢到了
有点神志不清的地步。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
I mean, normal people
don't say things like '^0000FFI am the most religious man in the universe! Kneel before me!^000000' Yeah. Not a normal thing to say.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我是说，正常人
不会说像'^0000FF我是宇宙中最虔诚的人！跪下吧！^000000'这样的话。对。这不是正常人会说的话。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, if the squad
leader punished anyone for insubordination, I'm sure that it was unwarranted. I don't remember too much, but I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
总之，如果小队长
因为违抗命令而惩罚了任何人，我确信那是毫无道理的。我记不太清了，但我对此很确定。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Excuse me, I need to take some Green Herbs. Taking these seems
to be the only thing that works for my headache.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
抱歉，我需要吃点绿色药草。吃这个似乎
是唯一能缓解我头痛的方法。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJack O busily chewed
on some Green Herbs.
It seemed to greatly relieve him from the pain of his headaches.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF杰克·奥忙着咀嚼
一些绿色药草。
这似乎极大地缓解了他头痛的痛苦。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Hey kid!
Ever think about
bein' a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
嘿，小孩！
有没有想过
成为十字军？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Hey kid!
Ever think about
bein' a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
嘿，小孩！
有没有想过
成为十字军？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Basically, you'd be volunteering to be part of our military, as well as train for the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
基本上，你是自愿加入我们的军队，
并为圣战进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
If you have some faith and know how to wield a sword, you'll be more than welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
如果你有信仰，并且知道如何使用剑，
这里将非常欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Just think about my suggestion
and come back if you're interested. Alright then, see you later~
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
考虑一下我的建议，
如果你感兴趣的话再回来。那么，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
Are you interested in knowing more about Crusaders? Hahaha, I guess that must be the case.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
哈...？
你对了解更多关于十字军的事情感兴趣吗？哈哈，我想应该是这样。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
By the way, bring a doll to
the kid in front of me. If you're lucky, she'll give you something neat in return. What it is, I don't know. I've got no dolls.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
顺便说一句，带个娃娃
给我前面的那个小孩。如果你运气好，她会给你一些不错的东西作为回报。是什么，我不知道。我没有娃娃。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
In accordance with the Crusader code, I'm not supposed to lie. So yeah, you can trust me!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
根据十字军守则，我不应该撒谎。所以，你可以相信我！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items!
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品太多了！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹气...*^000000 我没有收到他们的回复。我不知道
我还能等多久才能加入卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹气...*^000000 我没有收到他们的回复。我不知道
我还能等多久才能加入卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Oh, an adventurer! I actually used to work in the same field that you do. More specifically, I used to be a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
哦，一位冒险者！我实际上以前也从事过和你一样的工作。更具体地说，我以前是一名十字军。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
My name is Emma Searth. Right now, I'm following my dream and applying to be a Kafra Lady. So my days of wielding a sword are over.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我的名字是艾玛·西尔斯。现在，我追随我的梦想，申请成为卡普拉女士。所以我挥舞剑的日子结束了。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Sadly, I haven't succeeded yet because I was diagnosed with
some weird ^0000FFamnesia^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
不幸的是，我还没有成功，因为我被诊断出
患有奇怪的^0000FF失忆症^000000。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Of course, I understand that
Kafra Corporation is a large, professional company, but
if I can work for them even if it's just part-time...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
当然，我理解
卡普拉公司是一家大型、专业的公司，但
即使只是兼职，我也希望能为他们工作...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Is it that big of a problem?
I suppose they're worried
that I'd forget important customer information once I'm hired.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
这真的是个大问题吗？
我想他们担心我一旦入职，
就会忘记重要的顾客信息。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
It's strange. When I was
a Crusader, I remembered
everything lucidly, and I never had any problems recalling the past.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
这很奇怪。当我还是
十字军的时候，我记忆
非常清晰，回忆过去从未
出过任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
But now I get these migraines whenever I try to focus on my memories from those times
when I used to fight in the Prontera Military.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
但现在，每当我试图回忆
在普隆德拉军队服役时
的记忆，就会头痛欲裂。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
About her past.
scripts.translation: 关于她的过去

scripts.text: Why be a Kafra Lady?
scripts.translation: 为什么想成为卡普拉女士

scripts.text: About memories she can remember.
scripts.translation: 关于她记得的记忆

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe scent of your
Memory Bookmark
seems to bring clarity
to her thoughts.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你记忆书签的气味
似乎让她的思绪变得清晰。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I was born in a wealthy family where I was raised to learn etiquette, fencing, Peco riding, and music lessons since I was
born. I suppose you can say I'm pretty well educated.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我出生在一个富裕的家庭，
从小就被教导礼仪、击剑、
骑乘佩科和操控乐器。
我想可以说我受过良好的教育。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
However, my parents weren't
pleased when they learned that I wanted to become a Kafra Lady.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
然而，当父母得知我想
成为卡普拉女士时，
他们并不高兴。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
My parents insisted that
I become a Sage or a Scholar.
In the end, I ended up running
away from them by joining the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
父母坚持让我成为贤者
或学者。最后，我加入了
十字军，逃离了他们。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Luckily, the Crusaders were advertising their recruitment at the time, so I took that chance. Plus, having military experience might even help me join Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
幸运的是，当时十字军
正在招募，我就抓住了
这个机会。而且，有军事
经验也许能帮我加入卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Since I did so well in Boot Camp,
I got the chance to join an elite squad. My squad was often assigned difficult missions, and we never failed to complete those.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
因为我在新兵训练营表现
出色，我获得了加入精英
小队的机会。我们的小队
经常被分配艰难的任务，
但我们从未失败过。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Eventually, my reputation as a female Crusader, and being in a respectable military position, was enough to satisfy my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
最终，我作为女性十字军
的名声，以及我在军队中
体面的职位，足以让家人
满意。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
But after that day,
everything went wrong.
I only remember that it
was very sad and depressing.
Somehow, I feel like we were
even betrayed...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
但在那天之后，
一切都变糟了。
我只记得那天非常悲伤
和压抑。
不知为何，我觉得我们
甚至被背叛了...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I think I can
try to remember
my comrades...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我想我可以
试着回忆
我的同志们...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Ah, let's not talk about it. It's too depressing. Maybe if you had some sort of ^0000FFmemory^000000 aid, I might be able to recall my forgotten past. Anything, like a reminder, a scheduler, a bookmark, a string...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
啊，别谈这个了。太令人
沮丧了。也许如果你有一些
^0000FF记忆^000000辅助工具，我
可能就能回忆起被遗忘的
过去。任何东西，比如提醒
物、日程表、书签、绳子...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
One day, I happened to see Ms. Leilah at work here in Al De Baran. She was shining with confidence and commanded respect, even from her customers!
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
有一天，我碰巧看到莱拉
女士在艾尔帕兰这里工作。
她自信满满，令人尊敬，
甚至顾客们对她都充满敬意！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
She carried herself like a professional, no matter what the situation. Even though I knew she was tired from working in the summer heat, she made everything look effortless!
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
无论情况如何，她都表现得
非常专业。虽然我知道她
在酷暑中工作很累，但她
让一切看起来毫不费力！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
When the male customers try to flirt with her, she never loses her poise. She just adjusts her glasses and does what she needs to do.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
当男顾客试图搭讪她时，
她从不失态。她只是调整
一下眼镜，然后继续做她
需要做的事。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
To me, she's like a lone, guardian angel. At that moment, it seemed the world existed just to be mocked by Ms. Leila.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
对我来说，她就像一位孤独的守护天使。在那一刻，仿佛整个世界都只是为了让莱拉女士嘲笑而存在的。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I've also heard that Kafra Ladies are always traveling around the world, which is something I've always dreamed of doing.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我还听说，卡普拉的女士们总是周游世界，这也是我一直梦想着要做的事。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Ms. Leilah is my idol,
and she's the reason why
I want to become a Kafra Lady.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
莱拉女士是我的偶像，
也是我想成为卡普拉
女士的原因。

scripts.text: ^3355FFEmma Searth clutches her head and winces as she suffers from another migraine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾玛·西尔斯抱着头，因又一次偏头痛而痛苦地皱起眉头。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFRemembering that a Green Herb was able to relieve Jack O, you gave a Green Herb to Emma. She takes it, and looks a little more relaxed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF想起绿色药草曾让杰克·奥缓解过疼痛，你递给艾玛一株绿色药草。她接过去，神情看起来稍微放松了一些。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I'm not even sure
how much I can remember
and how much I've actually
forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我甚至不确定
自己还能记得多少，
又有多少是真正
被遗忘的。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Let me...
Try to remember every one in our squad. Let's see, there was Jack O, The Nineball. Z-Zan. Zan.H-Huadoku. C-Cuaque Donon. Myself. Um, E... Eni... Egni... Um...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
让我...
试着回忆一下我们小队里的每一个人。让我想想，有杰克·奥，九号球。赞...赞·华独。夸克·多农。还有我自己。嗯，E...恩尼...艾格尼...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Egni...
Egnigem?^000000
Who was that?
Oh no. I'm sure he might
have, no, was there someone
named that with us?
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
艾格尼...
艾格尼格姆？^000000
那是谁？
天哪。我确信他可能...不，我们队里
有叫这个名字的人吗？

scripts.text: ^3355FFEmma Searth clutches her head and winces as she suffers from another migraine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾玛·西尔斯抱着头，因又一次偏头痛而痛苦地皱起眉头。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I'm not even sure
how much I can remember
and how much I've actually
forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我甚至不确定
自己还能记得多少，
又有多少是真正
被遗忘的。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^0000FFJack O, The Nineball, Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon, Egnigem.^000000 Oh, I really miss those guys...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^0000FF杰克·奥，九号球，赞·华独，夸克·多农，艾格尼格姆。^000000 哦，我真想念那些家伙...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹气...*^000000 我没有收到他们的回复。我不知道
我还能等多久才能加入卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Egnigem...
That name makes
me so sad. I'm not
quite sure why, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
艾格尼格姆...
这个名字
让我感到悲伤。我不太
清楚为什么，但是...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Egnigem...
That name makes
me so sad. I'm not
quite sure why, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
艾格尼格姆...
这个名字
让我感到悲伤。我不太
清楚为什么，但是...

scripts.text: ^3355FFEmma turns away before you can see her cry. Still, her shoulders heave with each sob as you imagine the hardship she's had to endure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾玛转过身去，不让你看到她在哭泣。尽管如此，她的肩膀随着每一次抽泣而颤抖，你可以想象她所经历的艰辛。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I wish I knew what that name really means. I'm sure it's linked to an important memory from my past.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我真想知道这个名字到底意味着什么。我确信它与过去一段重要的记忆有关。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I really appreciate you coming here to talk to me about the old days. I, I want you to have this.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
非常感谢你来到这里，和我聊聊过去的事。我，我想把这个给你。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Egnigem...
That name makes
me so sad. I'm not
quite sure why, but...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
艾格尼格姆...
这个名字
让我感到悲伤。我不太
清楚为什么，但是...

scripts.text: ^3355FFEmma turns away before you can see her cry. Still, her shoulders heave with each sob as you imagine the hardship she's had to endure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾玛转过身去，不让你看到她在哭泣。尽管如此，她的肩膀随着每一次抽泣而颤抖，你可以想象她所经历的艰辛。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹气...*^000000 我没有收到他们的回复。我不知道
我还能等多久才能加入卡普拉公司。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I hear the Kafra Ladies always travel around the world, something I've always dreamed of doing! Hopefully, one of these days, I'll be able to work for the Kafra Corporation too.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
听说卡普拉的女士们总是周游世界，这也是我一直梦想着要做的事！希望有一天，我也能加入卡普拉总公司工作。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's discouraging. I haven't heard anything from them...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹息...*^000000
不过，这让人很沮丧。我还没有收到他们的任何消息...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Wha...?
You wanna talk?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
什...？
你想聊天？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
What am I, your personal psychiatrist?! Lemme alone,
I'm busy here! Awright, now
which one do I bet on...?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
我是你的私人心理医生吗？！别烦我，
我很忙！好吧，现在
我该押哪一个呢...

scripts.text: Talk about gambling.

Wha--? Him again?! Tell him I'm fine! Dandy, even! Why's he gotta send all these people just to ask
a silly question?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
什...？又是他？！告诉他我很好！简直棒极了！他干嘛非要派这么多人来问这种无聊的问题？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
1st Squad? Yeah, I used to be in that. All of us in the squad used to be real good buddies too.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
第一小队？对，我以前就在里面。我们小队的人以前都是很好的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon,
Jack O, Emma Searth and The Nineball. Yeah... I wonder what they're all up to?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
赞·华独、夸克·多农、杰克·奥、艾玛·西尔斯和九号球。是啊...不知道他们现在都在忙些什么？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Gambling? I love it, you
know? Eh, I don't win all the time, but I love it the most when I leave with more Zeny than I came in with! Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
赌博？你知道的，我超爱赌博！呃，虽然我不总是赢，但我最喜欢带着比进场时更多的Zeny离开！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Hobbies?
What, you comin'
on to me?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
爱好？
怎么，你要来找我茬？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
A man's hobby is drinking, or didn't you know that? I happen to be real good at it too! Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
男人的爱好就是喝酒，你不知道吗？我在这方面可是很在行的！呜哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Wha...?
You wanna talk?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
什...？
你想聊天？

What am I, your personal psychiatrist?! Lemme alone,
I'm busy here! Awright, now
which one do I bet on...?

我是你的私人心理医生吗？！别烦我，
我很忙！好吧，现在
我该押哪一个呢...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Hmm?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
嗯？
怎么了？

[Royal Myst]
Wha...?
You wanna talk?

scripts.text: Talk about gambling.
scripts.translation: 谈论赌博

scripts.translation: 聊聊爱好

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Huh? What's that old geezer want this time? Tell 'em I'm fine, dandy even! Why the hell does he keep sending people...
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
哈？那个老家伙这次又想干嘛？告诉他们我很好，简直棒极了！他到底为什么要一直派人来...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
What the hell!? Stop talking about him! I never wanna see his face again! Tell him to leave me the hell alone!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
该死的！别跟我提他！我再也不想看到他的脸了！告诉他别来烦我！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Damn geezer...
How much is he being paid for studying what we all found?! Eh, somehow, I don't care as long as
he pays me...
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
该死的老家伙...
他研究我们找到的东西能拿多少钱？呃，反正只要他付钱给我，我就无所谓...

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Yeah...
I just don't
care anymore.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
是啊...
我现在
什么都不在乎了。

1st Squad? Yeah, I used to be in that. All of us in the squad used to be real good buddies too.
scripts.translation:

第一小队？对，我以前就在里面。我们小队的人以前都是很好的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon,
Jack O, Emma Searth and The Nineball. Yeah... I wonder what they're all up to?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
赞·华独、夸克·多农、杰克·奥、艾玛·西尔斯和九号球。是啊...不知道他们现在都在忙些什么？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
1st Squad?
Don't know, don't care~
Do I look like a stupid Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
第一小队？
不知道，也不关心~
我看起来像个愚蠢的十字军吗？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Gambling? ! Oh man...
I love gambling, you know!
Heh, but I haven't been lucky enough to win yet. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
赌博？！天哪...
你知道的，我超爱赌博！嘿，但我还没幸运到能赢钱。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Gambling...!
Heh heh! Some risks you take,
and others you really shouldn't.
I can't help but feel sorry for that guy, E--
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
赌博...！
嘿嘿！有些风险你可以冒，有些则真的不该冒。
我忍不住为那个家伙感到难过，E--

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Ergh...?
Damn, I can never remember his name. You'd think I wouldn't forget the guy whose rap I'm taking but... Eh, I'll remember once I sober up.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
呃...？
该死，我总记不住他的名字。我以为我不会忘记那个我抢了他名声的家伙，但是...呃，等我酒醒了就会想起来的。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Hey, what do you think happens to Crusaders when they're framed and killed, huh? Where exactly do they go? Niflheim, Vahalla...?
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
嘿，你觉得十字军被陷害并杀害后会怎么样？他们到底会去哪里？尼弗尔海姆，瓦尔哈拉...？

Hobbies?
What, you comin'
on to me?
scripts.translation:
爱好？
怎么，你要来找我茬？

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
A man's hobby is drinking, or didn't you know that? I happen to be real good at it too! Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
男人的爱好就是喝酒，你不知道吗？我在这方面可是很在行的！呜哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Speaking of which,
I haven't had a drink
for a looong time. Almost
a couple hours now.
scripts.translation:
[皇家迷雾]
说到这个，
我已经很久没喝酒了。差不多
两个小时了。

scripts.text:
[Royal Myst]
Oooh, looks like you've got a tasty beverage I can enjoy. Bwahahaha! Gimmie~!

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Why have you returned to
this lonely place of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你为何回到
这孤独的黑暗之地？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Please go back to the world
of the living. To be here is to suffer, such is the nature of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
请回到生者的世界去吧。
留在这里只会受苦，这就是尼弗尔海姆的本质。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Greetings...
{0}.
I've been watching you in the
world of the living. I see you've been busy looking for the truth about the 1st Squad, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你好...
{0}。
我一直在生者的世界注视着你。看来你一直在寻找第一小队的真相，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I can provide you with the answers. After all, I'm the only member of the 1st Squad to retain all of my memories...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我可以给你答案。毕竟，我是第一小队中唯一保留所有记忆的成员...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Heh heh...
Let me tell you everything
about the 1st Squad that's
been forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嘿嘿...
让我告诉你
关于第一小队
那些被遗忘的一切...

scripts.text: The Mission
scripts.translation: 任务

scripts.text: Fate of the 1st Squad
scripts.translation: 第一小队的命运

scripts.text: Why are you in Niflheim?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在尼弗尔海姆？

scripts.text: Thanks, I've heard enough.
scripts.translation: 谢谢，我听得够多了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
First of all, the official record of our mission is misleading.
It contains some truth, based
on verbal evidence, but the most important details have been left out or changed.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
首先，关于这次任务的官方记录具有误导性。
虽然基于口头证词包含了一些事实，但最重要的细节被遗漏或篡改了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, we were secretly assigned
to find ^0000FFgodly artifacts^000000 by royal decree. In only three days, we succeeded and found Megingjard!
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
当时，我们奉王室密令，秘密寻找^0000FF神器^000000。仅仅三天，我们就成功了，并找到了雷神腰带！

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, the records say the mission was unsatisfactory, correct? That would be because of me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
记录上写着任务结果令人不满意，对吧？那是因为我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Are you aware that Megingjard
was a belt worn by gods? It was actually one of the keys to Thor's great strength. Another name for it is the 'Girdle of Might.'
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你知道雷神腰带是众神佩戴的腰带吗？它实际上是托尔强大力量的一部分来源。它的另一个名字是“力量腰带”。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, if a human were to wear
that, there's a possibility that Megingjard would give him strength comparable to a god. Naturally, you'd be afraid of such a thing falling into the wrong hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
如果人类佩戴它，雷神腰带可能会赋予他堪比神明的力量。自然，你会担心这种力量落入错误的人手中。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In Rebarev Doug's mind, he
was the only person worthy of the belt since he considered himself the most religious person alive, and thus, closest to the gods.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
在雷巴列夫·道格看来，他是唯一配得上这条腰带的人，因为他自认为是世上最虔诚的人，因此最接近神明。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He made it clear to us that only he would wear Megingjard. Although he was our leader, some of us felt uneasy about him wearing the belt and not giving it to his superiors, our mission objective.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他明确告诉我们，只有他才能佩戴雷神腰带。虽然他是我们的首领，但我们中有些人对他佩戴腰带而不将其交给上级（我们的任务目标）感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Naturally, I opposed him. He was clearly unbalanced, and it would be dangerous to give him control of such power. It led to something of a fist fight between us.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我自然反对他。他显然精神失常，让他控制如此强大的力量是危险的。这导致我们之间发生了一场斗殴。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The rest of the squad couldn't
agree on whether or not we should simply obey our leader and let him have the belt. Some just wanted to complete the mission, while others were afraid of what might happen.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小队其他成员无法就是否应该服从首领并让他拥有腰带达成一致。有些人只想完成任务，而另一些人则担心可能发生的后果。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev didn't wait for us to decide. He destroyed Megingjard into pieces, intending to keep most of it and somehow reconstruct it later, and only bring one piece to the Prontera Military.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫没有等我们做决定。他将雷神腰带拆成碎片，打算保留大部分并设法日后重组，只带一片去普隆德拉军队。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He knew that he couldn't get
away with keeping all of Megingjard to himself, as the entire squad could easily discredit him.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他知道，如果他独吞雷神腰带，整个小队很容易就能揭穿他。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev knew
that he could deceive his
superiors by giving them just a fragment of the artifact, and say that the rest of it was destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫知道，他可以通过只给上级一片神器，并声称其余部分已毁，来欺骗他们。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I discovered his intention when
I found him taking Megingjard apart. Before I could stop him,
I was killed. That bastard had
a trap ready for me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
当我发现他在拆解雷神腰带时，我察觉到了他的意图。在我阻止他之前，我就被杀了。那个混蛋给我设了陷阱...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
After the mission, Rebarev Doug only gave a piece of the belt back to the higher-ups, and gave them
a different account than what had actually happened...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任务结束后，雷巴列夫·道格只把腰带的一片交还给了上级，并给出了与实际发生情况不同的说法...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Once the mission was completed, Rebarev Doug reported back to the Prontera Military with the intent of keeping most of Megingjard for himself.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任务完成后，雷巴列夫·道格向普隆德拉军队报告，意图将大部分雷神腰带据为己有。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
For some reason, he has a very strong influence in the military hierarchy. Now, by this time, I'm sure the squad pretty much figured out that he killed me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
不知为何，他在军队高层中有很大的影响力。此时，我相信小队成员已经意识到是他杀了我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev Doug expected this, and explained to his superiors that the squad was tempted by Megingjard's power and that I led some of us in a mutiny against him.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫·道格预料到了这一点，并向他的上级解释，说小队被雷神腰带的力量诱惑，而我领导了一些人叛变。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He told his superiors that Megingjard was damaged as we
fought amongst each other, and that the fragment he gave them was all that remained.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他告诉上级，雷神腰带在我们内斗中受损，他交给他们的碎片就是仅存的部分。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Because of the confidential nature of our mission, the 1st Squad was disbanded and we weren't given the story Rebarev fed the beaureaucrats until it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
由于任务的机密性质，第一小队被解散了。雷巴列夫·道格向官僚们汇报的故事直到为时已晚才浮出水面。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The squad was punished and
sent for disciplinary retraining for three months. During this time, specific memories were unnaturally erased from the squad members.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小队受到了惩罚，并被送去接受为期三个月的纪律再培训。在此期间，小队成员的部分记忆被非自然地抹去了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In the end, everyone was transferred to other squads and positions. My name had to be removed from all the records since hearing or reading my name might undo the brain washing.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
最终，所有人都被调往其他小队和职位。我的名字必须从所有记录中删除，因为听到或读到我的名字可能会解除洗脑。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
However, they still needed an official scapegoat, so they used Royal Myst's name in the records. That's probably why he's been going through hard times right now.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
然而，他们仍然需要一个官方的替罪羊，所以他们在记录中使用了皇家迷雾的名字。这可能就是他最近过得艰难的原因。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
And now Rebarev Doug has been studying godly artifacts based on the pieces of Megingjard that we found on that mission using kingdom research funds. Someday, he might be able to reconstruct the belt.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
现在，雷巴列夫·道格正在利用王国研究资金，基于我们在任务中发现的雷神腰带碎片研究神圣神器。总有一天，他可能会重建这条腰带。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
There are also
a few questions that
I've never been able
to answer.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
此外，还有几个问题
我一直无法回答。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I've never known why the King Tristram III ordered the research of godly artifacts. It also bothers me that Rebarev Doug is in charge of Megingjard's research. There must be some reason.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我从未知道为什么特里斯特兰三世国王下令研究神圣神器。雷巴列夫·道格负责雷神腰带的研究也让我感到不安。一定有什么原因。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In any case, for the sake of Midgard, it will be your responsibility to find the answers.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
无论如何，为了米德加尔特，找到答案将是你的责任。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
There's not much a dead man
can do. But what's worse is that no one remembers me any more. I died alone and I'm still lonely in this place for the dead.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
死人能做的不多。但更糟糕的是，现在没人记得我了。我孤独地死去，在这个死人的地方依然孤独。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The worst part of the squad
having their memories erased is
that Emma Searth has absolutely
no recollection of me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小队记忆被抹去最糟糕的部分是
艾玛·西尔斯完全
不记得我了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Do you mind listening
to me for a while? You're
the only person with whom
I can talk about this...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你介意听我说一会儿吗？你是
唯一能和我谈论这些的人...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
From here, I've seen that Emma
is chasing her dream again, and
I'm happy for her. But it's still
not easy, knowing the woman you
love has totally forgotten you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
从这里，我看到艾玛
再次追逐她的梦想，
我为她感到高兴。但知道
你深爱的女子完全忘记了你，
这依然不容易。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I remember the first time I met her. I guess it was love at first sight. But I was too cowardly to confess my love, so I despaired when she joined the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我记得第一次见到她的时候。我想那是一见钟情。但我太胆小，不敢表白，所以当艾玛加入十字军时，我感到绝望。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
It took me a while, but I made up my mind to enlist as a Crusader
as well. I wanted to be closer to her so much.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我花了一段时间，但终于下定决心
也加入十字军。
我想离她更近一些。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, after all our adventures and good times together, I'm in the worst possible scenario.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
现在，在我们所有的冒险和美好时光之后，我陷入了最糟糕的境地。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I'm dead...
But I don't even have the consolation that she is
mourning my loss.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我死了...
但我甚至没有她为我
哀悼的安慰。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I suppose that's why I'm here
in Niflheim. I can't quite move on to heaven, Valhalla or anywhere else without her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我想这就是为什么我在
尼弗尔海姆。没有她，
我无法前往天堂、瓦尔哈拉或任何其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Anyway, go and visit the Crusader Headquarters. You might be able to learn more about Rebarev Doug and stop any new shadiness he might be plotting. Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
总之，去拜访十字军总部吧。你可能会了解到更多关于雷巴列夫·道格的信息，并阻止他可能正在策划的新阴谋。祝你好运，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Thank you for
listening to me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
谢谢你
听我说话...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
As a Crusader...
This is the best thing
I can do in return for
what you have done for me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
作为一名十字军...
这是我能为你
所做之事回报你的
最好方式。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Listen...
I'm going to
imbue you with the
^666666last vestiges of my strength^000000...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
听我说...
我将把^666666我最后的力量^000000注入你的体内...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
May the heavens
answer me as I call upon the
light of justice that empowers the defenders of truth, and threaten the enemies of peace.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
愿上天回应我的呼唤，赐予真理守护者正义之光，并威慑和平的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
May you always shine with
the light of truth. Let the light within you eradicate the shadows
of deception, fear and malice.
scripts.translation:

愿你永远闪耀真理之光。愿你心中的光芒驱散欺骗、恐惧与恶意之影。

invested in me, I humbly bestow upon you my remaining strength. Fight honorably, and do not lose sight of righteousness.
scripts.translation:

the light of truth. Let the light within you eradicate the shadows
of deception, fear and malice.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
愿你永远闪耀真理之光。愿你心中的光芒驱散欺骗、恐惧与恶意之影。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
By the holy power
invested in me, I humbly bestow upon you my remaining strength. Fight honorably, and do not lose sight of righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
凭借赋予我的神圣力量，我谦卑地将我剩余的力量赐予你。请光荣地战斗，切勿迷失正义。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Were you betrayed by fate as well, or are you simply a wanderer that's stumbled into this land of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你也是被命运背叛了吗？还是只是一个误入这片黑暗之地的流浪者？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hmm, the living don't deserve
to be in this realm of cold and suffering. But I can only help you escape by telling you what little
I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嗯，生者不配身处这寒冷与痛苦之地。但我只能告诉你我所知道的一点信息，助你逃离。

scripts.text: Ask him about buildings.
scripts.translation: 询问关于建筑的信息

scripts.text: Remove marks on mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图上的标记

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I see. If you better understand Niflheim's layout, you have a greater chance of surviving and escaping.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我明白了。如果你更了解尼弗尔海姆的布局，生存和逃脱的机会就会更大。

scripts.text: Tool Shop

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

You can find her castle at the ^FF3355+^000000 mark I've made on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:

尼弗尔海姆的女巫...
你可以在小地图上我做的^FF3355+^000000标记处找到她的城堡。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hrrrm...
It seems that the living who wind up in Niflheim are seeking out the witch. But I don't quite understand what's so important about her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嗯...
看来来到尼弗尔海姆的生者都在寻找那位女巫。但我不太明白她为何如此重要。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The Tool shop? Here in Niflheim, they sell some unique items that
you can't buy anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
工具店？在尼弗尔海姆，那里出售一些你在别处买不到的独特物品。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
You might want to see their
wares for yourself. I've drawn
a ^CE6300+^000000 on your mini-map to mark
its location.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你或许想亲自去看看他们的商品。我在小地图上画了一个^CE6300+^000000标记来标示它的位置。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I've marked the location of the Weapon Shop at ^55FF33+^000000. There's nothing too special over there, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我在^55FF33+^000000标记处标示了武器店的位置。不过那里没有什么特别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Tavern is at ^3355FF+^000000. They only sell drinks to the dead, though...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
酒馆在^3355FF+^000000。不过他们只向死者出售酒水...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Choose 'Remove marks on mini-map' from the menu to remove all the building location marks I've made.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
从菜单中选择“移除小地图上的标记”即可移除我做的所有建筑位置标记。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Alright, all the marks I've made have been removed from your mini-map. If you want to check the locations in Niflheim again, go ahead and ask me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
好的，我做的所有标记都已从小地图上移除。如果你想再次查看尼弗尔海姆的位置，尽管来问我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
You're gonna explore this place on your own? Pretty brave, aren't you? Just be careful: here in Niflheim, darkness reigns supreme.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你要独自探索这个地方吗？真勇敢啊。不过要小心：在尼弗尔海姆，黑暗才是主宰。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I really wish that
Emma Searth could
remember me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我真希望艾玛·西尔斯能记得我...
